card.name: Digits inside numbers in results
card.fires_on: Single digits or decimal points partway through a number in trial results, such as percentages, confidence intervals and ranges. It fires on the middle of the number, not on the first digit or the end.

modes.label: Decimal digits in statistics
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a percentage, confidence interval or range value.

modes.label: Digits in counts and percentages
modes.description: A digit partway through a percentage given next to a patient count.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number in a results table or statistic, where the digits are still being written out.
